title: The Senseless Ambiguity of North American Turn Signals
summary: Technology Connections explains why North American tail light rules, which allow red turn signals and flashing brake lights, make signals ambiguous. He argues for amber signals and cites studies showing a safety benefit.
why: HN points to it as the informative explanation of US turn signal quirks whenever signal design comes up.

quote.text: did a very informative (though a bit ranting) video on them in the US. Worth a watch and really interesting.
